title: C04 revision 1: answer review PR #76 (cutoff, quantifiers, coordinate convention, ledger producers)
body:
## Result and scope

Refs #45

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/45#issuecomment-6835732783, session `ADB991-claude-20261112-74c4`
- Unit IDs or other outputs: package C04 of YM-000026, meaning the eleven C04 chapters in `manuscript/existence/` and the author reports in `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C04/` (not `review/`)
- Human contributors and agent assistance: written by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent for @ADB991. Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

This is author revision 1 of C04. It answers the independent agent review merged in PR #76 (`results/C04/review/`). That review found no false statement and no invalid proof step, and requested textual changes. At the base, all eleven chapters had exactly the hashes the review lists, so the review applies to the text revised here.

**Chapter changes (each line maps to a review item):**
- M1 `locality.tex`: the cutoff sentence was false as literally written. It now uses f_R = χ(X/R)f with supp f_R ⊆ supp f ⊂ O_ij and f_R → f in 𝒮, as in `prop:boost-ward`.
- M4 `complex-heat.tex`: new paragraph declaring the time-first coordinates of Sections 40–50 and identifying them with the time-last convention of `statement.tex`.
- M5 `reconstruction.tex`, `prop:word-motion`: the hypothesis now reads ∀a ∀b ∃ε(a,b) > 0 with h_t(τ_a b) = T_E(a)h_t(b) for 0 < t < ε. This matches `YM.Boundary.Cups.time`.
- M6 `heat-vectors.tex`, `prop:heat-cups`: the statement now contains the translation identity for every a ∈ ℝ⁴, word b and t > 0, with τ_a and T_E defined. The proof already established it.
- M10 (all six clarifications):
  - `lem:tensor-tests`: explicit frequency cutoff.
  - `prop:tube-identification`: density argument applied to the two outer functionals.
  - `thm:joint-boundary`: weak-* continuity in y.
  - `spectral-measure.tex`: a self-contained π–λ argument replaces "uniqueness by Riesz".
  - `cor:cone-support`: wording of the label action.
  - `lem:schwartz-motion` is now stated for A ↦ f∘A⁻¹ on the whole invertible affine group, which its proof already covered, and `cor:word-motion-inputs` cites that form.

No theorem's content changed. `label-descent.tex` is unchanged.

**Report changes:**
- `ledger.md`:
  - E3 and E5 producers are named by label: `ex-phase-slab-bounds`, `ex-slab-laws`, `ex-phase-dynamics`, `ex-individual-rotations`.
  - E5 is split into E5a and E5b.
  - The null-equality producer is `ex-no-new-null`.
  - New edge E4b, original null ⊆ selected null, produced by `ex-phase-original-null`.
  - **E4 (field levels, inclusions, union) is marked "producer statement not identified"**, with Lean anchors.
  - The C14 outgoing edge is split into a Euclidean-spectral edge and a relativistic edge, which removes the apparent cycle.
  - The nonzero-label clause is recorded on the C16 edge (review M3).
  - The full C05 edge statement is copied in.
  - The locality row is corrected.
- `correspondence.md`:
  - `YM.Bid.C08` is in `Corners.lean` and is a conjunction.
  - `Urs W K` is the *conclusion* of `thm:lorentz-covariance`.
  - The continuity step takes a different route from the source; this is now recorded.
  - Corrections L3 and L4 for `reconstruction-evidence.md` are written out for that file's owner. C04 does not own it.
- `findings.md`, `handoff.md`, `validation.md`, `README.md`: revision record and final hashes.

**Still uncertain / open:**
- E4 has no producing chapter that I could find. It is shared by C05 and C14, so a coordinator should assign it.
- The nonzero-label endpoint clause needs a producer outside C04. A Lean candidate is `YM.Table.alive` with `YM.Table.pin_inj`.
- The producers named by label for the other incoming edges were not re-checked for content.
- M9 (the Williams locator in the shared bibliography) is left to G03.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Base: `codex/existence-monograph` at `d02fcb5`; rebased onto `26c1e7f`, which touches no C04 file.
- Commands actually run and results:
  - `latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -outdir=build existence.tex`: exit 0, 897 pages, no undefined references. There is one warning (`amsmath` "Foreign command \\atopwithdelims"); it comes from `\\choose` in two non-C04 chapters.
  - `main.tex`: exit 0, no warnings.
  - Rendered pages 169, 185 and 197 were inspected visually; the pdftotext output for pages 168–197 has no `??`.
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: OK, 4 units.
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 OK.
  - `git diff --check`: clean.
  - Every Lean declaration newly cited was located with `grep` at its stated path and line.
- Checks not performed and why:
  - No Lean build, elaboration or `#print axioms`: Mathlib sources and cache are blocked in this sandbox.
  - The cited literature was not re-inspected.
  - The content of the C03/C14 producer statements was not re-checked.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units:
  - `prop:heat-cups` and `lem:schwartz-motion` were strengthened in their *statements* only (to what their proofs give).
  - The `prop:word-motion` hypothesis is weaker (eventual in t, per word), so every existing use remains valid.
  - The YM-000026 fingerprint changes because ten C04 chapters changed.

- [x] Source citations and hypotheses have been checked, where applicable (text reads only).
- [x] Applicable literature results were sought; substantive steps have detailed proofs or verified references.
- [x] Structural checks pass.
- [x] Draft/reviewed status is accurate; stale reviews were cleared or renewed (ten chapters changed and need renewed review).
- [ ] The issue has a handoff and links to any durable Bots notes (handoff follows on #45).

Required next review: renewed independent mathematics and Lean-correspondence review of the changed C04 chapters and reports (not by the author).
